book.name: Mak tokbaut Zizas
book.title: Mak tokbaut laip ane tising blo Zizas

content: Zizas ile wan paralaizman
Piudei apta, Zizas bin gobaigen po Kapaniam ane ebriwan wea da taun bin lisen niuz dat em bin kambaigen.
Dat aus wea Zizas bin stap i bin gad tumas pipol, kan pit enimo pipol insaid. Ane i bin gad plenti pipol raitraun wea dat aus. Zizas bin tise dem wod blo God po dempla.
Orait. Po man bin kare wan paralaizman kam wea mat wase stresa.

Dempla bin teke da man po go insaid po putem prant wea Zizas, bat i bin gad plenti pipol. So dempla bin go antap wea da rup ane dempla bin meke oll wea da rup, stret antap wea Zizas i bin stanap. Dempla bin taite rop wea da mat den ol bin slaike da mat godaun prant wea Zizas, wea em bin stanap.
Wen Zizas bin luk dat bilib blo dempla, em bin spik po da paralaizman, ‘Mai boi, ai tekemaut ol dem nugudwei blo yu.’
I bin gad sam Zuwislotisa uda bin sidaun de, ane ol bin smolsmoltok diskain,
‘Uda dis man? Em spik badtok gense God. Wen em tekemaut sin em i meke emselp wase God. Mata God ken tekemaut sin.’
Bat Zizas sabe wanem dempla bin tingbaut, so em bin spik stret po dempla, ‘Ei, lugaut! Ai sabe wanem yupla tingbaut.
Wanem yupla tingk kai? I moizi po spik po dis man diskain, “Yu nogad no sin nau” o po spik po em, “Gedap ane wagbaut?”
Ai go soe yupla! Ai wande yupla po sabe diswan. Ai da Truwan blo Man, ai kare lo ya wea ert po tekemaut sin.’ Den Zizas bin slu po da paralaizman ane spik,
‘Gedap, rolemap mat blo yu ane go aus. Ai bin meke yu gud.’
Da man bin stanap prant wea dempla, rolemap mat blo em ane wagbaut go tru da bigmob pipol. Wen dempla bin luk, ol bin nadakain seik.
Zizas singaut Libai
Den Zizas i bin godaun po edz blo da leik gen. Nau ol bigmob pipol bin kam po em po lisen po Zizas ane em bin lane dempla.
Wail em wagbaut go, em bin luk wan taksman. Neim blo em Libai. Libai em i boi blo Alpias. Em sidaun wea taksopis blo em.
Dat seim nait Libai bin meke big kaikai po Zizas ane ol klostuman blo em, po dem nada taksman ane ol dem nada nugudpipol uda bin pole Zizas.

Sam dem Zuwislotisa uda bin Parasi i bin de. Wen dempla bin luk dem pipol kaikai wea Zizas, dempla bin spik po dem klostuman blo Zizas, ‘Ei! Aukam Zizas i kaikai ane dringk melen wea ol taksman ane ol dem nada man? Dempla ol nugudman!’

Wen Zizas bin lisen dempla tok diskain, em ansa dempla, ‘Ol sikpipol nide dokta, no dem strong eltiwan. Ai no bin kam po spik ol demwan uda tingk dempla rait ane stret, po seinze wei blo dempla. Ai bin kam po spik ol demwan uda sabe dempla nugud, po seinze nugudwei blo dempla.’
Tokbaut pasting

Wantaim dem klostuman blo Zon Baptaizman ane dem Parasi ol bin pasting. Sam pipol i bin kam po Zizas ane aske em diskain, ‘Ol dem klostuman blo Zon Baptaizman ane dem klostuman blo dem Parasi, plentitaim dempla pasting. Bat wiswei ol klostuman blo yu? Dempla no pasting.’
So Zizas bin aske dempla, ‘Wiswei yupla tingk? Yupla ken meke ol weding gest no kaikai wen da man uda go maret em stil de melen wea dempla? Nono! Yupla kan.
Da taim go kam wen da man uda bin maret, em go libe dempla olgeda. Datwan da taim nau wen dempla nogo kaikai.’
“Nobodi teke niu kaliko po pasem wea oul kaliko. Da niu kaliko i go strese dat oul kaliko ane spoilem ane dat oll i go kam mobig.
‘Pipol no kapsaid niu wain insaid oul skinbaig. Ip ol i mekem diskain, da niu wain go base da oul skinbaig ane da wain i go kapsaid ausaid. Mobeta yupla kapsaid da niu wain insaid wea niu skinbaig.’
Tokbaut Sabatdei

Orait nau. Wan Zuwis Sabatdei, Zizas bin wagbaut wea wan gadan wea ol groe wit po meke plaua. Dem klostuman blo em bin de ane dempla bin broke sam sided. Dempla bin tekemaut dat ausaid skinpat ane ol bin kaikai dat insaid sidpat.
Sam dem Parasi bin aske em, ‘Watpo ol klostuman blo yu bin broke dem lo? Dempla bin meke wok wea Zuwis Sabatdei. Yupla sabe. Yupla no lau po broke sided po kaikai wea Sabatdei.’
Zizas bin ansa dempla, ‘Yupla bin ridem wanem King Deibid ane ol man blo em bin mekem wen dempla bin anggre?

I bin da seimtaim wen Abiata bin bosprist. Deibid bin go insaid da aus blo God. Em bin kaikai da spesil opringbred blo God, wea mata dem prist i lau po kaikai. Ane Deibid bin gibe sam bred po ol dem man uda bin de wea em.’
Den Zizas bin spik gen, ‘God i meke da Sabatdei po man. Em no meke man po Sabatdei. Ai da Truwan blo Man gad antap paua. Mata mi ken kare dem lo blo da Sabatdei bikoz ai da BosLod blo da Sabatdei.’
